requirement.summary: HQ - Migrate system_tools functions to admin page (Platform Dev)
requirement.description:
Enhancement Details

- Platform Dev case for https://jira.shijidev.com/browse/HERO-67972

Our major account customer has a security policy that does not allow user account creation for Shiji staff in Infrasys POS HQ to be assigned the Administrator role.

However, the local server backend tool (aka system_tools) has a few functions that require users with the "Administrator" role; this creates a scenario where the hotel IT needs to temporarily assign the "Administrator" role to Shiji support staff to run these functions.

To move the following functions from system_tools to Infrasys POS admin page

- Recover Sales Data

- Request Export Transaction File in HQ

- Request Data Recovery

The functions above should be moved into "POS System > Data In". They should be available only in the local transaction server's admin page.

The above functions should also have their corresponding configuration for access control. Under User Management > Access Control > System

requirement.summary: POS API - accept API user number as employee id if request mark delivery from Shiji KDS（QA Testing）
requirement.description:
Enhancement:

Add interface code as request parameter in POS mark delivery API.

If interface = shiji_KDS, the employee id and emlpoyee password will follow the application user number.
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-67630/Epic-56913] POS API - accept API user number as employee id if reuest mark delivery from Shiji KDS (Jaylen)
Descriptions:
It is available for Api portal and Shiji KDS interface only
System to use default user defined in interface for the mark delivery function through API portal
Add a new field - interface code in Mark Delivery
The target Shiji KDS interface needs to be attached in the outlet setting
System overwrites the value of “applieduserno” by the value in “Default API Portal Request User No.”
If the value of “Default API Portal Request User No.” is empty, system follows the existing handling to process mark delivery
If the value of “Default API Portal Request User No.” is invalid user number, system returns error message
Workflow
1. System receives API portal request for mark delivery
2. If the new field about interface code exists, go to next step
3. If “interfacecode” does not exist, follow the existing handling to process mark delivery
4. If the interface code value is not a Shiji KDS interface. go to step 8
5. If the interface code value is a Shiji KDS interface, go to next step
6. If the “Default API Portal Request User No.” value is empty, go to step 8
7. If the “Default API Portal Request User No.” value is NOT empty, the system will use the value as the “applieduserno” to verify the user, go to step 9
8. The system will use the “applieduserno” from the request
9. System validates if the function apply user is a valid user
10. If it is not a valid user, system follow existing handling to return error message for invalid user
11. If it is a valid user, system continues to the existing handling of mark delivery
Setup:
For detailed setup of Shiji KDS interface, please refer to “infrasys_cloud_pos_release_note_1_0_104_0(Infrasys Cloud v1.2.104.0).doc”

requirement.summary: POS - Allow KDS to trigger POS mark delivery for printing - Dev(QA Testing)
requirement.release_notes:
Enhancements: [Jira-67146/Epic-60066] POS - Allow KDS to trigger POS mark delivery for printing - Dev (Jaylen)
Descriptions:
It is available for Api portal
System supports a new API request for mark delivery for Shiji KDS interface usage
Use existing API Cloud logic to let Shiji KDS interface to trigger the mark delivery action
Only available for old items
Support multiple items in one request
System support mark delivery for all items of a check when no items are given in the request
System supports a new action print queue for mark delivery
It is available for API portal only, not required to support normal POS workstations
Workflow for API portal
1. System receives API portal request for mark delivery
2. If target table is not occupied, system returns the error message and action abort
3. If target table is locked by others, system return existing error message and action abort
4. Open target table
5. System validate is any Shiji KDS interface attached outlet
6. If Shiji KDS interface is attached, system uses the provided internal check item ID to identify the target item
7. If Shiji KDS interface NOT attached, system use the item unique key (related to setup 1) to identify the target item
8. System verify whether the corresponding item exists in check or not
9. If the corresponding item is not found, the system skips this item and goes to step 13
10. If the corresponding items of the provided the item unique keys are found, go to step 11
11. If the corresponding items marked as delivered previously, treats as failed item for step 15, the system skips this item and goes to step 13
12. If the corresponding item is NOT marked as delivered, system marks it as delivered
13. Back to step 8 for next item OR go to step 14 if it is last item
14. If setup 2 exists, system prints the slip mark delivery action slip
System ignores the record of setup 2 with value set as “Mark Delivery” as this is for normal workstation only
15. If any items are successfully marked as delivered, the system returns a successful response
If there are items that fail to be marked as delivered, the system returns the successful response with failed items and the corresponding reasons
16. If all items fail to be marked as delivered, the system returns an error response
Setup:
For detailed setup of Shiji KDS interface, please refer to “infrasys_cloud_pos_release_note_1_0_104_0(Infrasys Cloud v1.2.104.0).doc”
Enhancements: [Jira-57492,Jira-57493,Jira-57494,Jira-58836/Epic-56913] POS - New KDS interface
Setup for action print queue
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System à Printing Setup à Action Print Queues
Select
Available in Locations = Target shop or outlet
Action Type = Target action type for mark delivery (Api Portal)
Print Format = Target print format
Click “Save” to save record
Setup for “Item References Settings” under Config by Location
Go to Infrasys POS platform: POS System à Ordering Setup à Config by Location
Select setup “Item References Settings”
Click “Add New” to add new record or edit existing record
Select
Apply To = Target location
All Locations = For all locations
Shop = For a specific shop
Outlet = For a specific outlet
Station = For a specific station
Shop = Target shop (available only if “Shop” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Outlet = Target outlet (available only if “Outlet” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Station = Target station (available only if “Station” is chosen in the row “Apply To”)
Enable API portal generate item unique key = Yes (Setup 1)
Click “Save” to save record
